mapper.sql: b.id, b.employee_id, b.year, b.leave_quota_hours, b.leave_used_hours, b.compens_earned_hours, b.compens_used_hours, b.updated_at, e.name AS employeeName, (b.compens_earned_hours - b.compens_used_hours) AS compensAvailable, (b.leave_quota_hours - b.leave_used_hours) AS leaveAvailable
mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id, year, leave_quota_hours, leave_used_hours, compens_earned_hours, compens_used_hours, updated_at FROM att_leave_balance WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND year = #{year}
SELECT FROM att_leave_balance b JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = b.employee_id WHERE b.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND b.year = #{year}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO att_leave_balance (employee_id, year, leave_quota_hours) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{year}, #{quotaHours}) ON CONFLICT (employee_id, year) DO NOTHING
